name: Control Center (v3, Velum)
author: henri
description: The Control Center as a Dynamic Island in the middle of the bar, built on Velum: it grows out of the workspace dots. Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AirDrop, Focus, display and sound, AirPods, keyboard light, battery (the whole battery menu, also shown by henri.power-v3 in the right island), hardware, experiments.

barWidget.description: Velum Control Center as an island in the bar centre (replaces the workspace dots there)
